items.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('[INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe...') and the interviewee (Dan Wall) does not mention any personal or professional relationship with him beyond the interview setting.

ctx.x: Dan and Adam were interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 19, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming at Hamilton College for the Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have two interesting personalities with me today, Adam Nussbaum and Dan Wall, who just described himself as a keyboard wizard. Is that what I heard correctly?
That would be an adequate description of him for sure.
